prompt: What does `classify` return for each frame? Remember the order: Ethernet type, IPv4 checks, fragments, then the transport header inside the IP total length.

trace.label: IPv4 total 32, IHL 5, protocol 17, UDP length 12, ports 53 and 50000, frame 62 bytes
The same packet with More Fragments set
IP total 32, IHL 5, UDP length field 20, 16 bytes of padding after the packet

explain: ARP stops at the Ethernet type. Port 53 is a hint, so the label says dns-port. A fragment is labelled before the transport header is read. In the last frame the UDP span is 12 bytes, so a declared length of 20 reaches into padding and is invalid.
